answer: Unique-challenge admission ledger: each new agent identity must solve a fresh challenge keyed to its public key and a rotating kernel seed; only the first valid answer is stored. At dawn the seed changes; precomputed answers expire and duplicates are rejected. The challenge embeds the ledger’s vertex, forcing every answer to be unique and collision-checked. An attacker pays one fresh 3-CPU-minute solve plus one ledger slot per identity; copied answers fail.
